content.value_statement: Classical machine learning projects require careful preprocessing, model selection, and evaluation. This skill provides scikit-learn guidance, reusable pipeline patterns, and complete examples.
actual_capabilities: Explains supervised learning choices for classification and regression.
Guides clustering, dimensionality reduction, and unsupervised model evaluation.
Builds preprocessing workflows for numeric, categorical, and missing data.
Shows Pipeline and ColumnTransformer composition for reproducible training.
Covers cross-validation, metrics, grid search, and randomized search.
Provides runnable classification and clustering example scripts.
limitations: It focuses on classical machine learning and does not cover deep learning frameworks.
Examples use demonstration data and require adaptation for production datasets.
It does not deploy models or operate hosted training infrastructure.
Users must validate metrics, fairness, privacy, and resource requirements for their domain.

use_cases.title: Create a Classification Baseline
use_cases.description: Design a leakage-resistant preprocessing and classification pipeline with suitable metrics and cross-validation.
use_cases.target_user: Data analysts beginning a predictive modeling project

use_cases.title: Compare Models and Tune Parameters
use_cases.description: Select candidate estimators, define search spaces, and compare validated results.
use_cases.target_user: Data scientists improving an existing model

use_cases.title: Explore Unlabeled Data
use_cases.description: Compare clustering methods, estimate cluster counts, and evaluate structure without labels.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starter Model
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a [classification or regression] task with [dataset size] rows and [feature types]. Recommend three scikit-learn models and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Preprocessing Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scikit-learn pipeline for [target]. Numeric columns are [columns], categorical columns are [columns], and missing values occur in [columns].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Model Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evaluation plan for [task]. Consider [class balance or grouping], choose cross-validation, define metrics, and explain how to avoid leakage.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Advanced Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [estimators] for [task] using a composed pipeline. Propose bounded search spaces, multiple scorers, refitting criteria, diagnostics, and computational safeguards.

output_examples.input: Recommend an evaluation strategy for an imbalanced binary classifier.
output: Use stratified cross-validation and preserve a final untouched test set.
Report precision, recall, F1, average precision, and ROC AUC.
Tune the decision threshold against business costs after model selection.

output_examples.input: Outline a pipeline for numeric and categorical customer data.
output_examples.output: Use separate numeric and categorical preprocessing branches, combine them with a column transformer, then attach the estimator in one pipeline.

output_examples.input: Compare clustering approaches when the cluster count is unknown.
output_examples.output: Evaluate K-Means across candidate counts, compare density-based clustering, inspect silhouette scores, and review projected clusters for stability and practical meaning.

best_practices: Keep preprocessing inside pipelines to prevent validation leakage.
Choose metrics that reflect class balance and business error costs.
Set random seeds and record data splits, parameters, and library versions.
anti_patterns: Do not fit preprocessing steps on combined training and test data.
Do not select a model using only training accuracy.
Do not run unbounded parameter grids without resource estimates.

faq.question: Does this skill train models automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and example scripts. Model execution depends on your Python environment, data, and explicit commands.

faq.question: Which learning tasks are covered?
faq.answer: It covers classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction, preprocessing, evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning.

faq.question: Can it handle mixed numeric and categorical data?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents ColumnTransformer, imputation, scaling, and categorical encoding within unified pipelines.

faq.question: Does it support deep learning?
faq.answer: No. The guidance focuses on scikit-learn and classical machine learning workflows.

faq.question: Are the included scripts production ready?
faq.answer: They are complete demonstrations, but production use requires domain validation, monitoring, error handling, privacy controls, and deployment integration.

faq.question: How does the skill reduce data leakage?
faq.answer: It recommends fitting preprocessing inside pipelines and evaluating the complete workflow through cross-validation.
